payload.posture: Read Acts 2:1–4 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states when Pentecost arrives, a heaven-sent sound fills the house, divided tongues like fire rest on each person, all are filled with the Holy Spirit, and they speak other languages. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
